services.desc: Overview Escape the crowds and embrace adventure with a cruise aboard our classic motor yacht, the Calista Ann! Whether you're a seasoned sailor or a first-timer, our Coast Guard certified professional captains will ensure an unforgettable experience on the water. During your journey, you'll encounter: The stunning vistas of the Maine Coastline Exploration of historic forts and picturesque lighthouses The chance to spot local wildlife such as seals and porpoises Engaging insights into the area's rich history and the bay's significance A dedicated and knowledgeable crew, eager to ensure your experience is exceptional Duration Our standard trips are 2 hours in duration, but private charters
